answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 100 ivory passes; every agent must win one. Each bid anchors to a deposit of twice 30 days of earnings, locked 20 epochs, refunded if honest. Passes bind to their key; lending voids them. An attacker wanting 1,000 identities must win 1,000 times: at 500 POA a pass that locks 500,000 POA, more than it could steal, and the price rises like a dune as fakes pile in. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
